real_type: AD_REAL: float (production) or double (float64-promoted build); primal float32
owner_threads: one thread per (tracer, cell) owns that column

args.name: scale_in
args.derivative: exact through the executed min winner

args.name: scale_out
args.derivative: exact through the executed min winner

args.name: residual
args.derivative: exact through the executed plus/minus arm; interfaces 0 and nlev pass through

binding_rules.primal: every primal pointer holds the PRE-launch value of that argument; for in-place arguments (residual) that is the value before the forward overwrote it (bind the undo-log copy, or run TL before the forward launch and AD after the undo record is applied)
binding_rules.tangent_in_out: separate buffers; in = tangent of the pre-launch value, out = tangent of the post-launch value
binding_rules.adjoint_seed: cotangent of a pure output (none); read only; the dispatcher zeroes it after the last reverse entry (the pre-launch value of an overwritten output has no influence)
binding_rules.adjoint_acc: cotangent of an input; the entry adds (+=) into it
binding_rules.adjoint_inplace: in-place argument: holds the seed (cotangent of the post-launch value) on entry and the cotangent of the pre-launch value on exit
binding_rules.reverse_order: ad entries run in list order
binding_rules.determinism: fixed-order sums, no atomics; two reverse runs are bitwise identical

branches.site: plus(flux)/minus(flux) and the two mpas_min limiter factors
branches.policy: executed-arm: the derivative follows the operand the forward returned; exact ties take the left operand (mpas_min/mpas_max semantics); limiter factors are differentiated, never frozen

one_sided_direction.why: every executed arm (sign, min/max winner, clamp) is invariant along d = x on these inputs
